Looking for that full-time job with training and growing opportunities? Work only in the day shift? Look no further! You found your  new job as a warehouse employee at Xenos in Waalwijk!
Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email!

What we offer
- Work in only day shifts
- Full-time work
- Salary of €14,99 per hour
- A friendly and cosy working atmosphere!
- Reimbursement of travel expenses
- Work in different departments

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse employee:

- You have your own transport to go to Waalwijk.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in day shifts.
- You are available at least 2 days during the week.

Sofas, chairs, confetti cannons, candles, cushions... Xenos has it all! As a warehouse employee, you’ll work among all this fun, colorful stuff. You work at the department for all of the products for the Xenos stores. You’re going to be driving around on an EPT to get all the different products! You put everything where it needs to go. You don’t need any prior experience, we’ll teach you everything!
This job is for the dayshifts only. You'll work from 07:00h until 16:00h. Awesome, right?!
Xenos pays different wages per age:

- 18 jaar: €7,50/hour
- 19 jaar: €8,99/hour
- 20 jaar: €11,99/hour
- 21+ jaar: €14,99/hour

Where will you work
You have probably already seen the Xenos stores! They are located all throughout the country! You will recognize Xenos by their fun, yellow logo 💛. Xenos has great products for your home. You will often see them in the warehouse! You will also get a great discount at the Xenos stores!
As a warehouse employee you will have great colleagues. You take breaks together and you are well supported by the team leaders. You’ll definitely feel welcome here!
